The application uses AI and image recognition to analyze charts and predict market moves.
Users can snap a picture of any trading chart, including stocks, forex, or crypto, and receive actionable insights such as 'Buy,' 'Sell,' or 'Hold' with a confidence score.
Key features of Trade Traditor include image capture and analysis, machine learning predictions, and actionable insights.
The application identifies patterns, indicators, and trends using AI-powered computer vision and employs OCR to extract key details like price scales and timestamps.
